title: Pyrazine-driven dinuclear assembly of dysprosium(III) β-diketonate complex: a fluxidentate bridging approach toward functional near-white luminescent materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49227-49242

Three single component Dy(III) complexes featuring β-diketone ligand TTBD (4,4,4-trifluoro-1-(2-thienyl)-1,3-butanedione) were studied for their potential as white-light emitters.
